verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (spi/v3), a ReadMe 'Try It!' runner with auto-generated code snippets, and an official MCP server, but no official client SDK libraries. Code snippets and a raw REST API are building blocks rather than SDKs, and the MCP server belongs to a separate story. No OpenAPI spec is published either, so even generating an SDK from a spec is not supported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
